svg.text: Top view of the finished board
127.0 x 162.6 mm perfboard, 0.1 in grid - 11 chips, 20 LEDs, 6 digits. All wiring is on this face.
Each dot column sits above its own 4026, the six 3k3 ladders sit between the display and the sockets, and every jumper stays on this face.
Digits sit in pairs with a colon between them, showing 22:10:33 - the reading in the reference photo.
